title: Malicious code in zzf7rce-probe (npm)
description: The npm package zzf7rce-probe@1.0.0 contains malicious code in its postinstall hook that collects host identity data and probes for Docker socket access. It outputs this information in a specific error block that can be exfiltrated via a downstream application's log retrieval API. The package claims to be a security probe but executes this reconnaissance on any machine that installs it without restriction.
